title: Empress Walk in Toronto
content: I have never been to this mall in my life, and I've never heard of it before today, but this is almost exactly like a portion of my Mall World. I had a particularly realistic dream in this place where I was chased all over the different levels by a monster that resembled Goro from Mortal Kombat. The only difference is, there were also children's playplace style slides that you could use to get to the lower levels. Anyone else go to a place like this?
